transcript:
Advisor: Good morning Walter, it's Sarah. Thanks for making time for our spring review.
Walter: Morning, Sarah. I've got my folder right here. I printed last quarter's statement and marked it up.
Advisor: Of course you did. So the bond ladder is performing as expected. The 2025 Treasury rung matures in June, and we planned to roll it into a new five-year rung.
Walter: Good. Let's keep the bond ladder as is. I read the fee disclosure you sent, and I want to understand the 0.85% before we add anything new.
Advisor: Sure. The 0.85% is the annual advisory fee on the managed portion. It covers the management, rebalancing and our planning work. Your individual bonds held outside the program aren't charged that fee.
Walter: So that's on roughly the three hundred thousand in the managed account, not the whole thing. That's what I figured. I just wanted it in your words.
Advisor: Exactly right.
Walter: And when does that Treasury rung come due again?
Advisor: June.
Walter: Ha, you just said that. June. Sorry, I was writing down the fee numbers. Okay, roll it into the five-year like we discussed.
Advisor: Will do. Anything new on your side? How's Ellen?
Walter: Ellen's good. She calls every Sunday. She's still my trusted contact, keep her on file. I don't want anything fancy, Sarah. Steady income, low risk. That's been the plan for twelve years and it's worked.
Advisor: Agreed. I'll send the roll paperwork this week and we'll talk again in the fall.
Walter: Sounds good. Thanks, Sarah.
